facts.text: Peoplestown is named for the Peoples family, who originally owned land in this area.
Housing in Peoplestown began to appear in 1885 after the Atlanta Electric Railway built a line along Capitol Avenue.
Peoplestown occupies a low-lying part of the basin of Intrenchment Creek, the largest urban tributary of the South River.
The construction of the Downtown Connector in the 1960s required the teardown of several houses on the western side of Peoplestown.
Stanton Park was renovated as part of the development of the Atlanta BeltLine, which defines the southern border of Peoplestown.
MARTA began construction in 2024 on a Bus Rapid Transit line that will run through Peoplestown toward Downtown Atlanta.
